transcript: Speaker A: दादी आपको इंग्लिश न्यूज़पेपर समझ आती है? [Grandma, do you understand the English newspaper?] Speaker B: Yes, of course. I can understand English quite well. [Oh wow, you can even talk in English!] Speaker B: हां, पहले मुझे इंग्लिश समझ तो आता था पर बोल नहीं पाती थी। [Yes, earlier I understood English but couldn't speak it.] Speaker A: तो आपने इंग्लिश बोलना कैसे सीखा? It has an AI teacher. Practicing with it improved my English.] Speaker A: ओ अच्छा, पर ये ऐप महंगा होगा ना? [Oh okay, but this app must be expensive, right?] Speaker B: बिल्कुल नहीं, मैंने सिर्फ ₹1 में ही शुरू किया था। [Not at all, I started for just 1 rupee.] Speaker A: अरे वाह, फिर तो सारे लोगों को MySivi ऐप यूज़ करना चाहिए। [Oh wow, then everyone should use the MySivi app.] Speaker C: Download MySivi app now.

summary: An interviewer asks an elderly woman reading an English newspaper if she understands it. She responds in fluent English, explaining that she overcame her speaking barrier using the MySivi app's AI teacher. She promotes the app's affordability at just 1 rupee, urging viewers to download it.
